newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentine bank Suquia downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentine bank Suquia downgraded.

text.p: -- Merchant Bankers, an affiliate of Salomon Brothers, said Monday it was downgrading Argentina's Banco del Suquia to hold from buy.
-- Analyst Felix Danzinger wrote in a report that Suquia is trading at 1.7 times book value, a 35 percent discount to Banco Frances and Banco de Galicia . "We regard this valuation as fair."

-- "Suquia has lower asset quality and lower-than-expected return on equity than Frances and Galicia. As a consequence, it is more leveraged to high economic growth than these two banks. However we believe that this effect is already in the price."
-- "We foresse an increase in competition in Suquia's regional niche market..."
